neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The side table now has one continuous turned profile per leg, which improves its silhouette over v003. The sharply pinched leg rhythm and dark, uniform finish still fall short of the approved round-02 concept's fuller turned forms and warm oak/walnut response.
